# ANALYSIS: OPRA_REAL_FILLS_OOS_REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_FALSE

**Filed:** 2026-07-23
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are testing the impact of setting `require_bearish_fill_bar=false` (unblocking the bearish fill bar gate) on the engine's performance over the full OPRA real-fills OOS period (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). The hypothesis is that removing this gate will allow additional bearish trades that were previously blocked, potentially increasing P&L without harming the J anchor days (since the gate does not fire on those days).

## Mechanism

The gate `require_bearish_fill_bar` (in gates.py #7) blocks bearish entries when the fill bar is not bearish. Setting it to false removes this block, allowing bearish entries regardless of the fill bar's direction. Entry and exit logic remain otherwise unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, etc.).
